auth.email: Use the work email invited to DELACHE. OTP codes expire quickly — request a new one if needed.
auth.code: Enter the 6-digit code from your email. Digits only, no spaces.

cases.createSection: Create the matter with a clear court-facing title. City and priority help routing and deadlines.
cases.title: Short descriptive title of the dispute or property (e.g. “Cortocircuito — Calle Reforma 120”).
cases.court: Official court or juzgado name if known; leave blank if not assigned yet.
cases.city: City where the property or incident is located — used for logistics and maps.
cases.priority: Urgent for imminent hearings or safety risk; High for tight deadlines; Normal otherwise.
cases.search: Filter the grid by case number, title, court, city, firm, or expert.
cases.pipeline: Pipeline view groups expedientes by current status. Coordinators/admins can drag one step forward only when process gates for the current point are complete; blocked columns show a lock hint. Others open the case to advance. Filters and search apply to every column.
cases.fatality: Check only when the lawsuit involves a death. This unlocks the death-certificate requirement — do not infer it from uploaded files.

clientCases.section: Submit intake details your law firm already has. Staff will complete technical fields later.
clientCases.title: Matter title as the firm refers to it internally and with the court.
clientCases.court: Court or juzgado handling the filing, if known.
clientCases.plaintiff: Full name of the plaintiff (actor) as on the lawsuit.
clientCases.defendant: Full name of the defendant (demandado) as on the lawsuit.
clientCases.fatality: Check only when the matter involves a death. Staff will then require the death certificate.

finance.section: Internal payment tracking only — not fiscal CFDI invoices. Link every record to a case.
finance.case: Pick the expediente this advance or charge belongs to.
finance.type: Advance = depósito; Final = closing fee; Expense = reimbursable cost; Other = misc.
finance.amount: Total in the case currency (usually MXN). Use decimals if needed.
finance.issue: Check to mark the record as issued immediately; uncheck to keep it as draft.
finance.search: Search by invoice number or amount.

team.section: Invite staff or law-firm users. Law-firm invites require selecting their firm.
team.email: Must be unique. Invitation OTP is emailed to this address.
team.firstName: Given name as it should appear in the portal and emails.
team.lastName: Family name as it should appear in the portal and emails.
team.role: Admin manages team/settings; coordinator runs cases; expert does field work; legal/logistics/accountant have scoped access. Law firm user accesses the client portal.
team.lawFirm: Required for law-firm users — picks which firm they belong to.

calendar.section: Schedule inspections, meetings, or deadlines. Link a case when the event is case-specific.
calendar.title: Short label shown on the calendar (e.g. “Inspección ocular”).
calendar.type: Choose the event category so the calendar colors stay consistent.
calendar.startsAt: Local date and time when the event begins.
calendar.location: Address or meeting place — optional but helpful for field visits.
calendar.case: Optional link to an expediente for quick navigation.

documents.search: Search titles, case numbers, or OCR text across the document index.

settings.caseNumber: Tokens like {YYYY} and {SEQ} control how new case numbers are generated.
settings.lawFirm: Register firms before inviting their portal users.

caseDetail.location: Fill address fields for logistics; use GPS or geocode so maps and Street View work.
caseDetail.workflow: Forward status buttons stay disabled until the current process point gates are complete. Pause and cancel remain available. Add a reason for audits.
caseDetail.notes: Internal notes stay with staff. Keep facts short and dated.
caseDetail.assignments: Assign the right role. Mark one primary owner for accountability. Set a delivery date for the primary expert — it becomes an action item and notifies them.
caseDetail.expertDelivery: Optional when assigning the primary expert. Creates a deadline on the case and calendar, and includes the date in the assignment notification.
caseDetail.questionnaire: Capture site GPS, Street View link, power-line context, and observations before inspection.
caseDetail.reviewRequests: Open review stages with a clear due date and assignee.
caseDetail.inspections: Schedule the visit; add notes the field team will see on-site.
caseDetail.measurements: Record numeric readings with units and pole IDs when applicable.
caseDetail.evidence: Title photos clearly; GPS tags strengthen chain of custody.
caseDetail.logistics: Log trips and expenses against the case for reimbursement tracking.
caseDetail.report: Summarize findings and conclusions for legal delivery — be precise and neutral.
caseDetail.documentCategory: Tag each file with the process category the 12-point gates check (lawsuit, protesta, ratification…).
caseDetail.documentCategoryClient: Choose the intake or additional-doc type this file satisfies (lawsuit, medical record, croquis…).
caseDetail.documentsPanel: Checklist shows what blocks the current point. The top picker only tags the next upload; use Change category on each file to fix a wrong tag.

maps.address: Street and number of the property under review.
maps.city: Municipality / city for routing and jurisdiction context.
maps.country: Default México unless the matter is abroad.
maps.lat: Latitude in decimal degrees (e.g. 19.4326) or DMS (16°26'47.1"N).
maps.lng: Longitude in decimal degrees (e.g. -99.1332) or DMS (92°43'40.7"W).
maps.gpsText: Paste coordinates as “lat, lng” — decimal or DMS with N/S/E/W.

process.title: Electrical expert-witness workflow
process.helper: Each point has one accountable role, required artifacts, and (where noted) a business-day clock. The 3-day law-firm review sits inside the 10-day clock that starts when protesta is filed.
process.blockedHowTo: Complete the items below, then a coordinator or admin can advance the workflow.
process.blockedHowToOps: Complete the items below, then advance the workflow from Status controls.
process.blockedHowToUploader: Upload or backfill the missing documents in Documents (quick links below).
process.blockedHowToWaitAssignment: A coordinator or admin must assign a primary expert before this point can advance.
process.blockedHowToWait: Waiting on other roles to complete the items below. You cannot advance status from your role.
process.blockedNeedsAssignment: Open Assignments on this case and set a primary expert.
process.blockedDocsOwner: Intake documents are usually uploaded by the law firm in the client portal (Documents). Staff can backfill here if needed.
process.gatesClear: Requirements for this point are complete.
process.gatesClearAdvance: You can advance the status from the workflow controls.
process.gatesClearWaitOps: Waiting for a coordinator or admin to advance the status.

yourAction.ops: Point {{point}} — {{name}}. Coordinate the work below, then advance when gates are clear.
yourAction.uploader: Point {{point}} — {{name}}. You can help complete document or field requirements. Status advance stays with coordinators/admins.
yourAction.assignee: Point {{point}} — {{name}}. Focus on your assigned work. Coordinators/admins move status when ready.
yourAction.viewer: Point {{point}} — {{name}}. This stage is owned by other roles; use the checklist to see what is still missing.

process.ownershipIntro: Point {{point}} — {{name}}. RACI below shows who does the work and who advances.
process.advanceYouCan: Your role can change case status when gates are clear.
process.advanceOnlyOps: Only coordinators and admins can move the case to the next status.
process.assignmentHow: Assignment: coordinators/admins add staff with a role (expert, logistics, …). Mark one primary expert — that person owns the expediente after P2. Secondary assignments support reviews and field work.
process.assignmentLater: Primary expert assignment happens at point 2 (Assignment). Intake documents come first.
process.gatesBlocked: Cannot advance: required process artifacts or approvals are missing.

questionnaire.ready: Questionnaire submitted for internal legal review

finance.unpaid_invoices: Issued invoices, and draft advance/final invoices, must be paid or voided before completing the case
